agent-browser@0.38.1: live image only (test/live/image/tools, whose own .npmrc sets ignore-scripts): postinstall (node scripts/postinstall.js) runs shell commands with execSync: `ldd --version` on Linux (to tell musl from glibc), `npm prefix -g`, and `which` for four Chrome names on Linux; chmods the bundled bin/agent-browser-<platform> binary to 0755, or, when that binary is absent, downloads it from the GitHub release with no checksum or signature check; writes bin/.install-method; and, whenever npm's global bin/agent-browser is a symlink (a global agent-browser, Homebrew's included), replaces it with a link to this copy's binary, even on a local install (on Windows it rewrites the global .cmd and .ps1 shims instead). The image needs none of it: the tarball ships bin/agent-browser-linux-arm64, which the Dockerfile chmods and links into /usr/local/bin itself
esbuild@0.28.2: postinstall (node install.js) only verifies and relinks the @esbuild/<platform> binary; esbuild's JS API and bin/esbuild find that optional dependency without it (the neutral bundle test and npm run build use it with ignore-scripts)
fsevents@2.3.3: registry metadata only (hasInstallScript from the gypfile it was published with): the tarball ships a prebuilt universal fsevents.node and no binding.gyp or install hook, so nothing would run anyway; a darwin-only optional dependency of vite and rollup's file watchers, which npm test does not use
